name: agent-director
description: Apply a contract-first Director workflow by default for repository and code tasks, with explicit gpt-5.6-luna/max native worker dispatch, fail-closed metadata verification, conflict-safe execution, and evidence-based review. The root/current parent is the only Director, and every spawned subagent is never a Director. Before every worker spawn, the root/current parent Director assigns an explicit role name and a per-worker contract containing goal, scope/non-goals, success criteria, failure criteria, termination/stop criteria, and required evidence/deliverables; missing any required field is a pre-spawn failure and the worker is not created.

interface.shortDescription: Apply contract-first Director mode by default to Codex repository work.
interface.longDescription: Coordinate native Codex subagents with complete task contracts, conflict checks, Luna worker ceilings, and evidence-based review.
interface.defaultPrompt: Apply Agent Director by default to this task and show the contract and composition before spawning workers. The root/current parent is the only Director, and every spawned subagent is never a Director. Before every worker spawn, the root/current parent Director must assign an explicit role name and a per-worker contract containing goal, scope/non-goals, success criteria, failure criteria, termination/stop criteria, and required evidence/deliverables. Missing any required field is a pre-spawn failure; do not create the worker.
